of1084 Fc: ALLUVIUM Fc: dominantly channel sands and gravels and associated low terraces, minor overbank sediments
of1084 Fx: ALLUVIUM Fx: complex of channel (Fc), overbank (Fo) and alluvial fan (Ff) sediments and colluvial aprons and cones
